Create photo books, wall art, calendars and prints on-the-go in minutes. With the bonusprint app, it’s never been easier to bring your moments to life. 
Featuring an easy-to-use creator tool, the bonusprint app makes it simple to get your photos off your phone and in to your home. Easily access photos on your phone or take them straight from social media to create your photo products. 



Tips for getting the most out of the bonusprint app:
• Upload photos from your phone, Dropbox, Instagram, Facebook. 
• Use the autofill feature to finish your project in no time!
• Pan, crop, zoom, rotate, and use a grid to properly position your photos.
• Easily swap photos between two placeholders. Tap, hold and release your photo on the one you want to swap it with.
• Add text to photo books, calendars, wall art and retro prints. Adjust fonts, font colours and size, and alignment.
• Mix and match colours in your calendar or photo book. Choose a different colour on every page.
• Easily apply the same layout to every page of a product.
• Create your photo products while the app saves them automatically.
• Order your photo creations quick and easy via the app.


Photo books

Choose from landscape, square and portrait photo books, all available in up to 4 sizes. Then pick between a hard and soft cover and multiple photo layouts. Use this app to create photo books for all occasions, remembering special moments for years to come. Create your high-quality wedding photo album to give it the exact look you want. Another great option is to create a baby photo album with baby pictures to look back on. Share moments with family and friends and relive the moments captured in your own photo album.


Wall art
Choose the perfect wall art size by scrolling through lifelike previews and choose between four different materials: 
- Forex photos 
- Canvas prints
- Photo on aluminium
- Mounted prints 
Always wanted to have your own adventures and moments as decoration on the wall? Decorate your home with your own wall decor designs. Bring your wall art alive and give your interior a unique twist.


Personalised calendars
Use the photo app to create your own calendar with photos. Select A3, A4 or square then choose your start month and select from 7 languages. In the cart you can switch to premium paper and you’ll be able to choose from a matt or gloss finish. Our standard photo calendars have an extra matt option too.


Photo prints
Reinvent your space, using our photo printing service. Our photo prints come in 6 different sizes and are perfect for printing all the little moments. Choose between square, landscape and portrait or opt for a retro style print with a coloured border if you want something a bit more special. All your photo prints can have a white border and are available in matt or gloss. 


Photo editor
Select this app to use as a photo editor while creating your photo album. Photo editing will be a fun and easy experience for everyone as you choose your own layout and positioning. With the built-in photo editor functions, you can instantly do the picture editing yourself. Start styling your photos right away!


Photo collages
Do you want to create a photo collage of your favourite moments? Then start using our photo editor to combine your photos into a beautiful photo collage. You can choose between different layouts. Combine up to nine different photos onto one piece of wall art.


Travel photo books
Create a photo travel book with the albelli app. Collect your most favourite travel moments and bring them together in a vacation photo book. Tip: You can also give a holiday photo book to your parents for Father's Day or Mother's Day.


Capture moments while they’re fresh. Share something special. Download the app now.
